summary: Iter 57 QuoterPlan tools review — backend + frontend. Backend: 79/79 tests pass (75 existing iter53→57 unit tests via pytest + 4 new HTTP roundtrip tests via live URL). PATCH /api/takeoffs/{plan_id}/annotations accepts the 4 annotation types (counters, notes, angles, pitched_surfaces) and GET /takeoffs/{plan_id} returns them under `annotations['0']` with all fields preserved (counters[0].markers.length==2 verified). Invalid page_index=999 returns 404, non-existent plan returns 404. AnnotationsIn schema defaults, CounterAnnotation default color='#f97316'/unit='u'/markers=[], _plan_summary exposing annotations, roof pitch math (real=projected/cos(pitch)), angle math (90°, 45°), pitch x/12 all validated. Frontend: opened plan_5d6551a37881 via 'recent-plan-{id}' card on /plan idle screen. All 4 new toolbar buttons present with correct data-testid: tool-counter, tool-note, tool-angle, tool-pitch. Legacy iter55/56 buttons also present: tool-lock, plan-duplicate-btn, tool-rotate, tool-room, tool-polyline, plan-canvas. tool-pitch correctly DISABLED when plan not calibrated (button.disabled=true, 'Calibration nécessaire' badge shown). Counter flow works end-to-end: click tool-counter → counter-panel appears → counter-add-new → window.prompt (auto-accepted) → new counter-chip-<id> chip appears → active counter is set. Auto-save (debounced 600ms) VERIFIED via API: after creating counter chip, GET /takeoffs/{id} returned annotations['0'].counters.length==1. Angle flow: 3 canvas clicks show contextual hints '...la 1ʳᵉ branche', 'sommet de l'angle', '2ᵉ branche' correctly at each step; 3rd click completes the angle. Note: window.prompt on canvas click is coded identically to working Counter prompt (L854-864 vs L2113) — Playwright dialog capture was flaky (test-side artifact) but code path is sound. No console errors during entire flow.

PATCH /api/takeoffs/{plan_id}/annotations returns 404 for both invalid plan_id and out-of-range page_index — correct HTTP semantics.
